```{r setup}
#| label: setup

library(googlesheets4)
library(gargle)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)

# ── Authentication ──
# Looks for service-account credentials in the same place CI writes them
# (gsheets.json at the project root, created from the GSHEET_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
# secret) and falls back to the local .secrets/ folder used in development.
# Without this, a non-interactive render (quarto render / CI) silently fell
# back to gs4_deauth(), which fails against a private sheet with an opaque
# low-level curl error instead of a clear auth message.
local_secret_files <- if (dir.exists(".secrets")) {
  list.files(".secrets", pattern = "\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
} else {
  character(0)
}
credential_candidates <- c("gsheets.json", local_secret_files)
credential_candidates <- credential_candidates[file.exists(credential_candidates)]

if (length(credential_candidates) > 0) {
  gs4_auth(path = credential_candidates[1])
} else if (interactive()) {
  gs4_auth()
} else {
  warning(
    "No Google Sheets service-account credentials found (looked for ",
    "'gsheets.json' and '.secrets/*.json') and this is a non-interactive ",
    "render, so falling back to unauthenticated access. If the source ",
    "sheet is private, the read below will fail. To fix locally, copy your ",
    "service-account JSON to 'gsheets.json' at the project root (same file ",
    "CI creates from the GSHEET_SERVICE_ACCOUNT secret).",
    call. = FALSE
  )
  gs4_deauth()
}

# ── Google Sheet URL ──
sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11Y_EoYqFJOTTubbBCQkh1gV3kbX1cVQHapdzbwWUXK4"

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LIVE PUBLIC DEBT API -- Kenya Debt Counter (api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke)
# Reference list of all known endpoints. The "Key Metrics at a Glance"
# charts below pull their data from /api/debt/historical, topped up with
# /api/debt/current (linearly interpolated across any gap months) so the
# line runs right up to today rather than stopping at the last historical
# row; everything else in this report still reads from the Google Sheet
# above. Kept here for reference and for wiring up additional charts later.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Base URL:
#   https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke        (production)
#   http://localhost:8000                     (local dev)
#
# Debt
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/debt/current
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/debt/growth?unit={sec|min|hour|day|week|month|year}
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/debt/historical
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/debt/ratio
#
# Expenditure / finance
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/expenditure/current
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/expenditure/growth?unit=...
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/expenditure/historical
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/finance/historical
#
# Indicators
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/indicators/current
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/indicators/growth?unit=...
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/indicators/gdp/historical
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/indicators/population/historical
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/indicators/forex/historical
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/indicators/interest/historical
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/population/current
#
# Combined / dashboard
#   GET  https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/dashboard/all
#   POST https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/simulate
#
# AI features
#   POST https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/ai/chat
#   GET  https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/ai/suggestions
#
# Visitor analytics (site usage tracking, not debt data)
#   POST https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/visitor/start
#   POST https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/visitor/pageview
#   POST https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/visitor/action
#   GET  https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/visitor/metrics/aggregated
#   GET  https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/visitor/metrics/timeline?days=
#   GET  https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/visitor/metrics/top-pages?limit=
#   POST https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/log/visit
#
# Utility
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/
#   GET https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/health
#
# External third-party APIs called by the backend itself (not ours to query):
#   https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages   -- AI chat/suggestions
#   https://ipapi.co/json/                  -- visitor geolocation (frontend)
#   https://www.centralbank.go.ke/forex/    -- scraped for live forex (not a JSON API)

DEBT_API_HISTORICAL <- "https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/debt/historical"
DEBT_API_CURRENT    <- "https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/debt/current"

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# IEA COLOUR PALETTE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
iea_green  <- "#2E7D32"
iea_gold   <- "#C8A415"
iea_dark   <- "#1B5E20"
iea_light  <- "#81C784"
iea_red    <- "#C62828"
iea_blue   <- "#1565C0"
iea_orange <- "#EF6C00"
iea_gray   <- "#616161"

theme_iea <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", colour = iea_dark, size = 13),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "gray40", size = 10),
      axis.title       = element_text(colour = "gray30", size = 10),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = "gray40"),

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "bottom",

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPER: read one indicator row and pivot long
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
read_indicator <- function(sheet_name, indicator_label, skip = 3) {
  raw <- read_sheet(ss = sheet_url, sheet = sheet_name, skip = skip)
  raw %>%
    filter(Indicator == indicator_label) %>%
    select(-any_of(c("Indicator", "#"))) %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Quarter") %>%
    rename(Value = V1) %>%
    mutate(Value = as.numeric(Value)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value))
}

# Wrapper that returns NULL on failure (sheet or indicator missing)
try_indicator <- function(sheet_name, indicator_label, skip = 3) {
  tryCatch(read_indicator(sheet_name, indicator_label, skip),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │  CONFIGURE YOUR SHEET NAMES & INDICATOR LABELS BELOW        │
# │                                                              │
# │  Adjust these strings to match your Google Sheet exactly.    │
# │  If a sheet or indicator doesn't exist, the report will      │
# │  gracefully skip that section.                               │
# └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── 1. DEBT STOCK ──
# This is the one sheet read the whole report depends on, so failures here
# get a diagnostic message instead of a raw curl/httr stack trace.
df_total <- tryCatch(
  read_indicator("Debt Stock", "Total Public Debt (KSh bn)"),
  error = function(e) {
    stop(
      "\n\nFailed to read the 'Debt Stock' sheet from Google Sheets.\n",
      "This is almost always one of:\n",
      "  1. Missing/invalid credentials  -> place a service-account JSON at \n",
      "     'gsheets.json' (project root) or in '.secrets/'.\n",
      "  2. The service account lacks Viewer access to the sheet -> share\n",
      "     the sheet with the client_email in your service-account JSON.\n",
      "  3. No network access from this machine/runner right now.\n\n",
      "Sheet: ", sheet_url, "\n",
      "Original error: ", conditionMessage(e), "\n",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
)
df_dom   <- try_indicator("Debt Stock", "Domestic Debt (KSh bn)")
df_ext   <- try_indicator("Debt Stock", "External Debt (KSh bn)")

# ── 2. GDP ──
df_gdp   <- try_indicator("GDP", "GDP (KSh bn)")
df_gdp_g <- try_indicator("GDP", "GDP Growth Rate (%)")

# ── 3. FISCAL / FINANCE ──
df_rev   <- try_indicator("Finance", "Revenue (KSh bn)")
df_exp   <- try_indicator("Finance", "Expenditure (KSh bn)")

# ── 4. FOREX ──
df_forex <- try_indicator("Forex", "KES/USD")

# ── 5. WEIGHTED AVERAGE COST OF DEBT ──
df_wacd_dom <- try_indicator("WACD", "Domestic Interest Rate (%)")
df_wacd_ext <- try_indicator("WACD", "External Interest Rate (%)")

# ── 6. POPULATION ──
df_pop   <- try_indicator("Population", "Population (millions)")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# REPORTING PERIOD
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Calendar quarters: Q1 = Jan-Mar, Q2 = Apr-Jun, Q3 = Jul-Sep, Q4 = Oct-Dec.
# This report always covers the most recently COMPLETED quarter relative to
# the render date -- i.e. whatever quarter we are currently *in* is not yet
# finished, so the report looks one quarter back.
# Example: rendered on 9 Sep 2026 (which falls in Q3, Jul-Sep) -> report
# covers Q2 2026 (Apr-Jun 2026).
get_reporting_quarter <- function(ref_date = Sys.Date()) {
  yr <- as.integer(format(ref_date, "%Y"))
  mo <- as.integer(format(ref_date, "%m"))

  current_q <- ceiling(mo / 3)   # 1-4, the quarter ref_date falls in
  q         <- current_q - 1
  y         <- yr
  if (q == 0) { q <- 4; y <- yr - 1 }

  q_labels <- c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")
  q_ranges <- c("January \u2013 March", "April \u2013 June",
                "July \u2013 September", "October \u2013 December")

  list(
    quarter = q_labels[q],
    year    = y,
    label   = sprintf("%s %d", q_labels[q], y),
    range   = sprintf("%s %d", q_ranges[q], y)
  )
}

reporting_period <- get_reporting_quarter()

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COMBINE DEBT DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
df_all <- df_total %>% rename(Total = Value)

has_composition <- !is.null(df_dom) && !is.null(df_ext)
if (!is.null(df_dom)) df_all <- df_all %>% left_join(df_dom %>% rename(Domestic = Value), by = "Quarter")
if (!is.null(df_ext)) df_all <- df_all %>% left_join(df_ext %>% rename(External = Value), by = "Quarter")

# ── Derived debt metrics ──
n <- nrow(df_all)
latest_q       <- df_all$Quarter[n]
latest_total   <- df_all$Total[n]
prev_total     <- if (n >= 2) df_all$Total[n - 1] else NA
qoq_change     <- latest_total - prev_total
qoq_pct        <- (qoq_change / prev_total) * 100
yoy_total      <- if (n >= 5) df_all$Total[n - 4] else NA
yoy_change_pct <- if (!is.na(yoy_total)) ((latest_total - yoy_total) / yoy_total) * 100 else NA

if (has_composition) {
  latest_dom <- df_all$Domestic[n]
  latest_ext <- df_all$External[n]
  dom_share  <- (latest_dom / latest_total) * 100
  ext_share  <- (latest_ext / latest_total) * 100
}

# ── Feature flags ──
has_gdp     <- !is.null(df_gdp)
has_gdp_g   <- !is.null(df_gdp_g)
has_fiscal  <- !is.null(df_rev) && !is.null(df_exp)
has_forex   <- !is.null(df_forex)
has_wacd    <- !is.null(df_wacd_dom) && !is.null(df_wacd_ext)
has_pop     <- !is.null(df_pop)

# ── Debt-to-GDP ──
has_debt_gdp <- FALSE
if (has_gdp) {
  df_debt_gdp <- df_all %>%
    select(Quarter, Total) %>%
    inner_join(df_gdp %>% rename(GDP = Value), by = "Quarter") %>%
    mutate(Debt_to_GDP = round((Total / GDP) * 100, 1))
  if (nrow(df_debt_gdp) > 0) has_debt_gdp <- TRUE
}

# ── Debt per capita ──
has_debt_pc <- FALSE
if (has_pop) {
  df_debt_pc <- df_all %>%
    select(Quarter, Total) %>%
    inner_join(df_pop %>% rename(Pop = Value), by = "Quarter") %>%
    mutate(Debt_per_Capita_KSh = round((Total * 1e9) / (Pop * 1e6), 0))
  if (nrow(df_debt_pc) > 0) has_debt_pc <- TRUE
}

# ── Fiscal balance ──
has_fiscal_joined <- FALSE
if (has_fiscal) {
  df_fiscal <- df_rev %>%
    rename(Revenue = Value) %>%
    inner_join(df_exp %>% rename(Expenditure = Value), by = "Quarter") %>%
    mutate(Deficit = Expenditure - Revenue)
  if (nrow(df_fiscal) > 0) has_fiscal_joined <- TRUE
}

# ── WACD combined ──
has_wacd_joined <- FALSE
if (has_wacd) {
  df_wacd_combined <- df_wacd_dom %>%
    rename(Dom_Rate = Value) %>%
    inner_join(df_wacd_ext %>% rename(Ext_Rate = Value), by = "Quarter")
  if (nrow(df_wacd_combined) > 0) has_wacd_joined <- TRUE
}

# ── Tail helper for chart trimming ──
tail_factor <- function(df, max_n = 12) {
  if (nrow(df) > max_n) df <- tail(df, max_n)
  df %>% mutate(Quarter = factor(Quarter, levels = Quarter))
}

# ── Full-width table renderer ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# kableExtra's own full_width = TRUE emits a `tabu` environment, and `tabu`
# is broken under modern TeX Live/LuaHBTeX (undefined \tabu@cleanup at
# \end{tabu}) -- which is why every kable() in this report is pinned to
# full_width = FALSE and ends up squeezed in the middle of the page. This
# renders the same booktabs look by hand with `tabularx` instead: the first
# column sizes to its content and the remaining columns share the leftover
# width equally as centred X columns, so the table always spans the full
# text block margin to margin.
iea_tex_escape <- function(x) gsub("([&%$#_])", "\\\\\\1", as.character(x))

# raw_cols names columns whose cells are already LaTeX (e.g. a \textcolor
# status flag) and must therefore be passed through unescaped.
iea_fullwidth_table <- function(df, bold_rows = integer(0),
                                 header_bg = "ieagreen", bold_bg = "E8F5E9",
                                 raw_cols = character(0), caption = NULL,
                                 space_above = "1em") {
  cn      <- names(df)
  ncols   <- length(cn)
  colspec <- paste0("l", paste(rep(">{\\centering\\arraybackslash}X", ncols - 1L), collapse = ""))

  hdr <- paste0(
    "\\rowcolor{", header_bg, "}",
    paste(sprintf("\\textcolor{white}{\\textbf{%s}}", iea_tex_escape(cn)), collapse = " & "),
    " \\\\"
  )

  rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    vals  <- unlist(df[i, ], use.names = FALSE)
    cells <- ifelse(cn %in% raw_cols, as.character(vals), iea_tex_escape(vals))
    if (i %in% bold_rows) {
      paste0("\\rowcolor[HTML]{", bold_bg, "}",
             paste(sprintf("\\textbf{%s}", cells), collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
    } else {
      paste0(paste(cells, collapse = " & "), " \\\\")
    }
  }, character(1))

  # Caption sits above the table and consumes the LaTeX table counter, so
  # these hand-built tables stay in sequence with any kable() captions.
  cap <- if (is.null(caption)) "" else
    sprintf("\\captionof{table}{%s}\n", iea_tex_escape(caption))

  paste0(
    "\n", if (is.null(space_above)) "" else sprintf("\\vspace{%s}\n", space_above),
    cap,
    "\\begin{tabularx}{\\textwidth}{", colspec, "}\n",
    "\\toprule\n", hdr, "\n\\midrule\n",
    paste(rows, collapse = "\n"), "\n",
    "\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabularx}\n\n"
  )
}

# ── Value of a series at an exact date ──────────────────────────────────────
# The live debt series carries monthly points dated to the 1st of the month,
# plus occasional genuine reported dates (30 June, the fiscal year end).
# Snapping backwards to the closest earlier point therefore reads "as at end
# of March" off the 1 March point -- a full month early. Interpolating
# linearly to the exact target date fixes that, and where a real point
# already sits on the target date (30 June) it is returned untouched.
# Same calendar date n years earlier, used for the decade-ago comparisons in
# every figure's narrative. Shared here so no figure depends on another
# figure's chunk having run successfully first.
years_back_date <- function(d, n) {
  tryCatch(as.Date(paste0(as.integer(format(d, "%Y")) - n, format(d, "-%m-%d"))),
           error = function(e) d - n * 365.25)
}

value_at_date <- function(df, target_date, cols) {
  d   <- df[order(df$Quarter), ]
  out <- lapply(cols, function(cl) {
    y  <- d[[cl]]
    ok <- is.finite(y)
    if (sum(ok) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    approx(x = as.numeric(d$Quarter[ok]), y = y[ok],
           xout = as.numeric(target_date), rule = 2)$y
  })
  names(out) <- cols
  out$Quarter <- target_date
  as.data.frame(out)
}
```

```{r treasury-inputs}
# ── National Treasury inputs ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Everything in this report that is NOT derived from the live debt counter
# comes from published National Treasury / KNBS documents -- the Medium Term
# Debt Strategy (MTDS), the annual Budget Estimates, and national accounts.
# Those are periodic publications, not an API, so the figures are declared
# here rather than fetched. They are defined early because both the Figure 3
# commentary and the Debt Sustainability Analysis section read from them.
# UPDATE THIS BLOCK when a new MTDS, Budget Estimates or GDP release lands.
mtds_year   <- "2026"
budget_year <- "2026/27"

# Debt Sustainability Analysis thresholds vs latest assessed values (MTDS).
dsa_indicators <- data.frame(
  Indicator = c("PV of Public Debt / GDP",
                "PV of External Debt / Exports",
                "External Debt Service / Exports",
                "External Debt Service / Revenue"),
  Threshold = c(55.0, 180.0, 15.0, 18.0),
  Latest    = c(65.3, 182.2, 22.5, 20.6),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
)

# Weighted average interest rate on each debt class (MTDS).
wair_domestic <- 13.0
wair_external <- 3.9

# Share of the year's debt service budget, and its total (Budget Estimates).
service_domestic_share <- 70.6
service_external_share <- 29.4
service_total_trillion <- 2.3

# Pending bills -- arrears already owed to suppliers, contractors and
# counties. These sit OUTSIDE the headline debt stock reported by the debt
# counter, but are a real claim that is typically settled by borrowing.
pending_bills_trillion <- 0.8

# Latest real GDP growth. Preferred from the Google Sheet's GDP Growth Rate
# indicator when it is present; this declared value is the fallback.
# >>> CONFIRM against the latest KNBS release before publishing. <<<
real_gdp_growth_fallback <- 4.7

# MTDS projection horizon quoted in the closing narrative.
mtds_above_benchmark_until <- "2029"
```

```{r key-metrics-data}
# Pulls the FULL debt history (every data point, not just recent quarters --
# confirmed 324 monthly points, Sep 1999 to Jul 2026) live from the Kenya
# Debt Counter public API (DEBT_API_HISTORICAL, see the endpoint list near
# the top of this file). The API returns raw KSh (not billions), so values
# are divided by 1e9 here to match the "KSh Billions" scale used everywhere
# else in this report. Falls back to the Google Sheet data (df_all, full
# history, uncapped) if the API is unreachable at render time, so a network
# hiccup here doesn't break the whole report. Both charts below (Total, and
# Domestic vs External) are built from this same pull.
api_debt_hist <- tryCatch({
  resp <- request(DEBT_API_HISTORICAL) %>%
    req_user_agent("IEA-Kenya-QuarterlyReport/1.0 (+quarto render)") %>%
    req_timeout(25) %>%
    req_perform()
  parsed <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  if (!isTRUE(parsed$success) || is.null(parsed$data) || nrow(parsed$data) == 0) {
    stop("API responded but returned no usable data (success=", parsed$success, ")")
  }
  parsed$data %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(month_label = format(date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
    # The API can carry more than one row for the same calendar month (e.g.
    # a mid-month update) -- keep only the latest row per month.
    group_by(month_label) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    transmute(
      Quarter  = date,   # real Date (1st of month) -- drives scale_x_date below
      Total    = round(as.numeric(total)    / 1e9, 2),
      Domestic = round(as.numeric(domestic) / 1e9, 2),
      External = round(as.numeric(external) / 1e9, 2)
    )
}, error = function(e) {
  message(
    "Live debt API unavailable (status: ",
    tryCatch(class(e)[1], error = function(e2) "unknown"), " -- ",
    conditionMessage(e), ") -- falling back to sheet data."
  )
  NULL
})

# Sheet quarters are labelled like "Q1 2026" -- convert to the first day of
# that quarter's first month so the fallback path plots on the same real
# date scale as the live-API path above.
parse_quarter_label <- function(x) {
  q <- as.integer(sub("^Q(\\d).*", "\\1", x))
  y <- as.integer(sub(".*\\s(\\d{4})$", "\\1", x))
  as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", y, (q - 1L) * 3L + 1L))
}

# The live "current" snapshot (right now) can sit ahead of the last row of
# /api/debt/historical (which only updates periodically). Fetch it and,
# if it's genuinely newer, append it -- linearly interpolating any whole
# calendar months in between so the line doesn't jump straight from the
# last historical point to today's value.
current_snapshot <- tryCatch({
  resp_cur <- request(DEBT_API_CURRENT) %>%
    req_user_agent("IEA-Kenya-QuarterlyReport/1.0 (+quarto render)") %>%
    req_timeout(25) %>%
    req_perform()
  parsed_cur <- resp_body_json(resp_cur, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  if (!isTRUE(parsed_cur$success) || is.null(parsed_cur$data)) {
    stop("current endpoint returned no usable data")
  }
  d <- parsed_cur$data
  list(
    date     = as.Date(substr(d$timestamp, 1, 10)),
    Total    = round(as.numeric(d$total)    / 1e9, 2),
    Domestic = round(as.numeric(d$domestic) / 1e9, 2),
    External = round(as.numeric(d$external) / 1e9, 2)
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Live 'current' debt snapshot unavailable (", conditionMessage(e), ") -- historical series left as-is.")
  NULL
})

append_current_with_interpolation <- function(hist_df, current) {
  if (is.null(current)) return(hist_df)
  last_date <- max(hist_df$Quarter)
  if (current$date <= last_date) return(hist_df)  # nothing newer to add

  last_row <- hist_df[hist_df$Quarter == last_date, ][1, ]

  # Whole-month points strictly between the last historical point and now.
  gap_starts <- seq(last_date, current$date, by = "month")
  gap_starts <- gap_starts[gap_starts > last_date & gap_starts < current$date]

  all_pts    <- c(last_date, gap_starts, current$date)
  total_span <- as.numeric(current$date - last_date)
  frac       <- as.numeric(all_pts - last_date) / total_span

  interp <- tibble(
    Quarter  = all_pts,
    Total    = last_row$Total    + frac * (current$Total    - last_row$Total),
    Domestic = last_row$Domestic + frac * (current$Domestic - last_row$Domestic),
    External = last_row$External + frac * (current$External - last_row$External)
  )
  n <- nrow(interp)
  interp[1, c("Total", "Domestic", "External")] <- last_row[, c("Total", "Domestic", "External")]
  interp[n, c("Total", "Domestic", "External")] <- current[c("Total", "Domestic", "External")]

  new_rows <- interp[interp$Quarter > last_date, ]  # drop the duplicated last_date row
  bind_rows(hist_df, new_rows) %>% arrange(Quarter)
}

if (!is.null(api_debt_hist)) {
  key_metrics_trend_df <- append_current_with_interpolation(api_debt_hist, current_snapshot)
  key_metrics_has_composition <- TRUE
  key_metrics_source_note <- "Source: Kenya Debt Counter live API (api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke)"
} else {
  key_metrics_trend_df <- tail_factor(df_all, max_n = nrow(df_all)) %>%  # full history, uncapped
    mutate(Quarter = parse_quarter_label(as.character(Quarter)))
  key_metrics_has_composition <- has_composition
  key_metrics_source_note <- "Source: National Treasury / CBK via IEA Kenya (Google Sheet)"
}

series_colors <- c("Total" = iea_blue, "Domestic" = iea_green, "External" = iea_gold)

# Shared two-tier x-axis: "Jun"/"Dec" month ticks (horizontal, plain) with a
# bold year label centred underneath every second tick -- matches the
# reference dashboard style. With 27 years of history this is a lot of
# ticks (~54), so labels are kept small to stay legible.
key_metrics_yr_range <- as.integer(format(range(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter), "%Y"))

key_metrics_month_breaks <- as.Date(unlist(lapply(
  key_metrics_yr_range[1]:key_metrics_yr_range[2],
  function(y) c(sprintf("%d-06-01", y), sprintf("%d-12-01", y))
)), origin = "1970-01-01")
key_metrics_month_breaks <- sort(key_metrics_month_breaks[
  key_metrics_month_breaks >= min(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter) &
  key_metrics_month_breaks <= max(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter)
])

# One bold year label per year, centred on 1 July (between that year's Jun
# and Dec ticks) -- drawn just below the axis line via coord_cartesian(clip
# = "off") in each chart below, since it sits outside the data panel.
key_metrics_year_breaks <- as.Date(sprintf("%d-07-01", key_metrics_yr_range[1]:key_metrics_yr_range[2]))
key_metrics_year_breaks <- key_metrics_year_breaks[
  key_metrics_year_breaks >= min(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter) &
  key_metrics_year_breaks <= max(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter)
]
# Label only every 2nd year to stop the year row from overlapping itself.
key_metrics_year_breaks <- key_metrics_year_breaks[seq(1, length(key_metrics_year_breaks), by = 2)]

key_metrics_year_layer <- geom_text(
  data = data.frame(x = key_metrics_year_breaks, y = -Inf,
                     lbl = format(key_metrics_year_breaks, "%Y")),
  aes(x = x, y = y, label = lbl), inherit.aes = FALSE,
  vjust = 4.2, size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", colour = "black"
)

# Source note, drawn as its own text layer positioned below the year row
# (rather than ggplot's automatic caption, which was landing on top of the
# year row instead of underneath it once the axis grew a second row).
key_metrics_source_layer <- annotate(
  "text", x = min(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter), y = -Inf,
  label = key_metrics_source_note, hjust = 0, vjust = 7.6,
  size = 2.4, colour = "gray40"
)

key_metrics_x_scale <- function(right_expand = 0.015) {
  scale_x_date(breaks = key_metrics_month_breaks,
               labels = format(key_metrics_month_breaks, "%b"),
               expand = expansion(mult = c(0.015, right_expand)))
}
# Month labels rotated 90 degrees (vertical) so they don't collide at ~54
# ticks across the full history; the bold year row sits further below to
# clear the now-taller vertical month labels, and the bottom margin is
# widened further still to leave room for the source-note row below that.
key_metrics_x_theme <- list(
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off"),
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 5),
        plot.margin  = margin(t = 5.5, r = 8, b = 65, l = 5.5))
)
```

### Figure 1. Trends in Kenya's Debt (Ksh Trillion)

```{r key-metrics-total, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.3} 
library(ggthemes)
if (key_metrics_has_composition) {
  key_metrics_fig1_long <- key_metrics_trend_df %>%
    select(Quarter, Total, Domestic, External) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Total, Domestic, External),
                 names_to = "Series", values_to = "Debt") %>%
    mutate(Series = factor(Series, levels = c("Total", "Domestic", "External")))
} else {
  key_metrics_fig1_long <- key_metrics_trend_df %>%
    select(Quarter, Total) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = Total, names_to = "Series", values_to = "Debt")
}

key_metrics_fig1_endlabels <- key_metrics_fig1_long %>%
  group_by(Series) %>%
  filter(Quarter == max(Quarter)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("KSh %05.2f T %s", Debt / 1000, Series))

# Figures 1, 2 and 3 now share ONE Excel download instead of three separate
# files (kenya_public_debt_data.xlsx: a Snapshot sheet, the full
# Amount/Proportion/Per Capita/As % of GDP time series, and a Notes &
# Sources sheet). That workbook is actually built in the
# debt-data-xlsx-export chunk near the end of the document, once Figures 2
# and 3 have computed their own series -- this just defines the shared
# filename/URL and readiness flag that all three "Download Excel" captions
# below use, so they always agree on whether to show a link and where it
# points. Since the real file isn't written until later, readiness here
# just checks that openxlsx is installed rather than attempting a write.
debt_data_xlsx_name    <- "kenya_public_debt_data.xlsx"
debt_data_base_url     <- "https://wnwamalwa.github.io/quarterly-macro-debt-report/"
debt_data_download_url <- paste0(debt_data_base_url, debt_data_xlsx_name)
debt_data_xlsx_ok      <- requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)
if (!debt_data_xlsx_ok) {
  message("openxlsx not installed -- Download Excel links will be omitted from this render.")
}

# Figure 1's own source note drops the raw API domain and is combined
# with the real "Download Excel" hyperlink into one line printed below
# the chart (see the key-metrics-total-download chunk below), since text
# baked into the plot image itself can never be clickable.
key_metrics_fig1_source_note <- sub(
  "\\s*\\(api\\.kenyadebtcounter\\.or\\.ke\\)", "", key_metrics_source_note
)
# No longer drawn inside the plot -- it's combined with the "Download
# Excel" link into one line printed below the chart instead (see the
# key-metrics-total-download chunk), since text baked into the plot
# image itself can never be clickable.

# Dynamic "As at [date]" callout with a curved arrow pointing at the tip of
# the Total line. The date comes straight from the Total series' own latest
# data point (the same row used for its end-of-line value label above), so
# it updates automatically on every render as new data arrives -- nothing
# here is hardcoded.
ordinal_suffix <- function(day) {
  if (day %in% c(11, 12, 13)) return("th")
  switch(as.character(day %% 10), "1" = "st", "2" = "nd", "3" = "rd", "th")
}
format_as_at_date <- function(d) {
  day <- as.integer(format(d, "%d"))
  sprintf("As at %d%s %s %s", day, ordinal_suffix(day), format(d, "%B"), format(d, "%Y"))
}

key_metrics_fig1_tip   <- key_metrics_fig1_endlabels %>% filter(Series == "Total")
key_metrics_fig1_asat_label <- format_as_at_date(key_metrics_fig1_tip$Quarter)

key_metrics_fig1_xspan <- as.numeric(max(key_metrics_fig1_long$Quarter) - min(key_metrics_fig1_long$Quarter))

# Same "round up to the next KSh 2 Trillion" top break used by the y-axis
# ticks below (the "KSh 14 T" gridline etc.) -- the callout curves down
# from that gridline into the Total line's tip, so it always lines up with
# whichever tick happens to be the topmost one for the current data.
key_metrics_fig1_y_top_break <- ceiling(max(key_metrics_fig1_long$Debt) / 2000) * 2000

key_metrics_fig1_asat_x <- key_metrics_fig1_tip$Quarter - key_metrics_fig1_xspan * 0.10
# Sit below the top gridline (not on top of it) by a fifth of the tick
# spacing, so the callout clears the "KSh 14 T" label/gridline itself
# while still curving down from up near the top of the panel.
key_metrics_fig1_asat_y <- key_metrics_fig1_y_top_break - 2000 * 0.20

ggplot(key_metrics_fig1_long, aes(x = Quarter, y = Debt, colour = Series, group = Series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = series_colors) +
  geom_text(data = key_metrics_fig1_endlabels,
            aes(x = Quarter, y = Debt, label = label, colour = Series),
            hjust = 0, nudge_x = 250, size = 2.3, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  annotate("curve",
           x = key_metrics_fig1_asat_x, y = key_metrics_fig1_asat_y,
           xend = key_metrics_fig1_tip$Quarter, yend = key_metrics_fig1_tip$Debt,
           curvature = -0.2, angle = 90,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inches"), type = "closed"),
           linewidth = 0.4, colour = "gray30") +
  annotate("text",
           x = key_metrics_fig1_asat_x-4, y = key_metrics_fig1_asat_y,
           label = key_metrics_fig1_asat_label,
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.3, fontface = "italic",
           colour = "gray30") +
  key_metrics_x_scale() +
  key_metrics_year_layer +
  # Debt is stored in KSh Billions; y-axis ticks step every KSh 2 Trillion
  # (i.e. every 2,000 in the underlying Billions units) and are labelled
  # "KSh 00 T" .. "KSh 14 T" (etc.), matching the end-of-line "T" labels.
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, key_metrics_fig1_y_top_break, by = 2000),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("KSh %02d T", as.integer(round(x / 1000))),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.14))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_gdocs() +
  key_metrics_x_theme +
  # Restrict the panel itself (and therefore the gridlines and the x-axis
  # line) to the real data range, instead of inflating the scale to make
  # room for the end-of-line labels. clip = "off" still lets the labels
  # draw past that boundary, into the widened right margin below -- so
  # nothing (gridlines, axis line, or panel border) strays into label
  # territory anymore.
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(min(key_metrics_fig1_long$Quarter), max(key_metrics_fig1_long$Quarter)),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 16, r = 80, b = 65, l = 5.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black",size = 8))
```

```{r key-metrics-total-download, results='asis'}
# Combined "Source: ... (Download Excel)" line -- text baked into the
# ggplot image above can never be clickable, so this is the one place the
# source caption actually appears for Figure 1 now. The download link is
# only added when the Excel export actually succeeded this render, so it
# never points at a file that was not published; the source text alone
# still always prints, so attribution is never lost.
if (debt_data_xlsx_ok) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n\\vspace{-1.6em}\n\\begin{flushleft}\n{\\footnotesize\\color{gray} %s (\\href{%s}{Download Excel})}\n\\end{flushleft}\n",
    key_metrics_fig1_source_note, debt_data_download_url
  ))
} else {

    key_metrics_fig1_source_note
  ))
}
```

```{r debt-snapshot-summary, results='asis'}
# Summary paragraph + Domestic/External/Total composition table across
# three points in time (prior quarter-end, reporting quarter-end, and the
# live "as at" snapshot) -- all computed from the same merged trend data
# that feeds Figure 1 (key_metrics_trend_df) and the report's own
# reporting_period, nothing here is hardcoded. Plain markdown + kable()
# (not raw LaTeX) so Pandoc/kableExtra handle all the escaping themselves.
debt_summary_ok <- tryCatch({

last_day_of_month <- function(year, month) {
  first_next <- if (month == 12) as.Date(sprintf("%d-01-01", year + 1)) else as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", year, month + 1))
  first_next - 1
}

closest_on_or_before <- function(df, target_date) {
  cand <- df[df$Quarter <= target_date, ]
  if (nrow(cand) == 0) cand <- df
  cand[which.max(cand$Quarter), ]
}

q_labels_all     <- c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")
q_end_months_all <- c(3L, 6L, 9L, 12L)

fmt_trillion <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x / 1000)
fmt_pct_str  <- function(x) paste0(sprintf("%.0f", x), "%")
fmt_short_date <- function(d) {
  day <- as.integer(format(d, "%d"))
  sprintf("%d%s %s %d", day, ordinal_suffix(day), format(d, "%b"), as.integer(format(d, "%Y")))
}

# --- "As at" (live) snapshot: same latest point as Figure 1's arrow ------
asat_row         <- key_metrics_trend_df[which.max(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter), ]
asat_date_label  <- format_as_at_date(asat_row$Quarter)
asat_short_label <- fmt_short_date(asat_row$Quarter)

ten_years_ago_date <- tryCatch(
  as.Date(paste0(as.integer(format(asat_row$Quarter, "%Y")) - 10, format(asat_row$Quarter, "-%m-%d"))),
  error = function(e) asat_row$Quarter - 3652
)
row_10y       <- closest_on_or_before(key_metrics_trend_df, ten_years_ago_date)
ratio_10y_str <- sprintf("%.1f", asat_row$Total / row_10y$Total)

asat_domestic_str <- fmt_pct_str(asat_row$Domestic / asat_row$Total * 100)
asat_external_str <- fmt_pct_str(asat_row$External / asat_row$Total * 100)

# --- Daily accumulation rate: the slope of the most recent segment of the
# merged trend -- i.e. exactly the rate the live "current" point was
# interpolated at, so it reflects the latest known pace of accumulation. -
trend_sorted       <- key_metrics_trend_df[order(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter), ]
prev_row_for_rate  <- trend_sorted[nrow(trend_sorted) - 1, ]
day_span           <- as.numeric(asat_row$Quarter - prev_row_for_rate$Quarter)
daily_rate_str <- if (is.finite(day_span) && day_span > 0) {
  sprintf("%.2f", (asat_row$Total - prev_row_for_rate$Total) / day_span)
} else {
  "n/a"
}

# --- Close-of-quarter points: reporting_period (title page's quarter) vs.
# the quarter immediately before it. --------------------------------------
q_num       <- match(reporting_period$quarter, q_labels_all)
q_end_month <- q_end_months_all[q_num]
q_end_date  <- last_day_of_month(reporting_period$year, q_end_month)
q_end_row   <- value_at_date(key_metrics_trend_df, q_end_date, c("Total", "Domestic", "External"))

prev_q_num <- q_num - 1L
prev_year  <- reporting_period$year
if (prev_q_num == 0L) { prev_q_num <- 4L; prev_year <- reporting_period$year - 1L }
prev_q_end_month <- q_end_months_all[prev_q_num]
prev_q_end_date  <- last_day_of_month(prev_year, prev_q_end_month)
prev_q_end_row   <- value_at_date(key_metrics_trend_df, prev_q_end_date, c("Total", "Domestic", "External"))

q_domestic_str      <- fmt_pct_str(q_end_row$Domestic / q_end_row$Total * 100)
q_external_str      <- fmt_pct_str(q_end_row$External / q_end_row$Total * 100)
prev_q_domestic_str <- fmt_pct_str(prev_q_end_row$Domestic / prev_q_end_row$Total * 100)
prev_q_external_str <- fmt_pct_str(prev_q_end_row$External / prev_q_end_row$Total * 100)

col1_label <- sprintf("%s %s %d", q_labels_all[prev_q_num], month.abb[prev_q_end_month], prev_year)
col2_label <- sprintf("%s %s %d", reporting_period$quarter, month.abb[q_end_month], reporting_period$year)
col3_label <- asat_short_label

cat(sprintf(
  "**%s**, the public debt is estimated at Total debt: **KSh %s trillion**, and is **%s times** what it was a decade ago without correcting for inflation. Approximately **KSh %s billion** of new debt stock is added daily. The share composition of debt has evolved as follows:\n",
  asat_date_label, fmt_trillion(asat_row$Total), ratio_10y_str, daily_rate_str
))

debt_summary_table <- data.frame(Metric = c("Domestic", "External", "Total"),
                                  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
debt_summary_table[[col1_label]] <- c(prev_q_domestic_str, prev_q_external_str,
                                       sprintf("KSh %s T (100%%)", fmt_trillion(prev_q_end_row$Total)))
debt_summary_table[[col2_label]] <- c(q_domestic_str, q_external_str,
                                       sprintf("KSh %s T (100%%)", fmt_trillion(q_end_row$Total)))
debt_summary_table[[col3_label]] <- c(asat_domestic_str, asat_external_str,
                                       sprintf("KSh %s T (100%%)", fmt_trillion(asat_row$Total)))

TRUE
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Could not build the debt snapshot summary (", conditionMessage(e), ") -- section omitted from this render.")
  FALSE
})
```

```{r debt-snapshot-table, results='asis', eval=debt_summary_ok}
# Rendered with the hand-built tabularx renderer (see iea_fullwidth_table
# near the top of this file) rather than kable_styling(full_width = TRUE),
# which emits a `tabu` environment that is broken under modern TeX
# Live/LuaHBTeX. This spans the full text block, margin to margin.
cat(iea_fullwidth_table(debt_summary_table, bold_rows = 3,
      caption = "Composition of the public debt stock"))
```

### Figure 2. Trends in Debt per Capita (KSh)

```{r debt-per-capita-data}
# Debt per capita = the same combined Total/Domestic/External debt series
# behind Figure 1 (key_metrics_trend_df) divided by population, pulled live
# from the Kenya Debt Counter population endpoints and joined by calendar
# month (both series are independently interpolated to "today", so an
# exact-date join would miss points -- joining on year-month lines them up
# reliably). Falls back to the existing Population sheet (df_debt_pc /
# df_all, computed near the top of this file) if the live population API
# is unavailable, same defensive pattern as the debt data itself.
POP_API_HISTORICAL <- "https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/indicators/population/historical"
POP_API_CURRENT    <- "https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/population/current"

api_pop_hist <- tryCatch({
  resp <- request(POP_API_HISTORICAL) %>%
    req_user_agent("IEA-Kenya-QuarterlyReport/1.0 (+quarto render)") %>%
    req_timeout(25) %>%
    req_perform()
  parsed <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  if (!isTRUE(parsed$success) || is.null(parsed$data) || nrow(parsed$data) == 0) {
    stop("API responded but returned no usable data (success=", parsed$success, ")")
  }
  parsed$data %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(month_label = format(date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
    group_by(month_label) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    transmute(month_label, Population = as.numeric(value))
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Live population API unavailable (", conditionMessage(e), ") -- falling back to Population sheet.")
  NULL
})

pop_current_snapshot <- tryCatch({
  resp_cur <- request(POP_API_CURRENT) %>%
    req_user_agent("IEA-Kenya-QuarterlyReport/1.0 (+quarto render)") %>%
    req_timeout(25) %>%
    req_perform()
  parsed_cur <- resp_body_json(resp_cur, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  if (!isTRUE(parsed_cur$success) || is.null(parsed_cur$data)) stop("current endpoint returned no usable data")
  list(
    date       = as.Date(substr(parsed_cur$data$timestamp, 1, 10)),
    Population = as.numeric(parsed_cur$data$population)
  )
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Live population 'current' snapshot unavailable (", conditionMessage(e), ").")
  NULL
})

has_debt_pc_live   <- FALSE
debt_pc_source_note <- NULL

if (!is.null(api_pop_hist)) {
  pop_by_month <- api_pop_hist
  latest_hist_month <- max(as.Date(paste0(pop_by_month$month_label, "-01")))
  if (!is.null(pop_current_snapshot) && pop_current_snapshot$date > latest_hist_month) {
    pop_by_month <- bind_rows(
      pop_by_month,
      tibble(month_label = format(pop_current_snapshot$date, "%Y-%m"),
             Population  = pop_current_snapshot$Population)
    )
  }

  # Population is a slow, smooth series and its monthly grid does not
  # necessarily cover every month the debt series carries. An inner join on
  # year-month therefore dropped whole stretches of the debt series, which
  # is what made two different quarter-end columns in the table below
  # resolve to the same underlying row. Interpolate population linearly
  # onto the debt series' OWN dates instead, so every debt point gets a
  # per-capita value on exactly the same date grid Figure 1 uses. rule = 2
  # holds the first/last known population flat beyond the series' ends.
  debt_pc_df <- tryCatch({
    pop_dates <- as.Date(paste0(pop_by_month$month_label, "-01"))
    pop_ord   <- order(pop_dates)
    if (length(pop_dates) < 2) stop("need at least two population points to interpolate")

    pop_on_debt_dates <- approx(
      x    = as.numeric(pop_dates[pop_ord]),
      y    = pop_by_month$Population[pop_ord],
      xout = as.numeric(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter),
      rule = 2
    )$y

    # Domestic and External per-capita trends, divided by the same population
    # series as Total -- mirrors Figure 1's Total/Domestic/External composition.
    key_metrics_trend_df %>%
      mutate(Population = pop_on_debt_dates) %>%
      filter(is.finite(Population), Population > 0) %>%
      transmute(Quarter,
                Total    = (Total    * 1e9) / Population,
                Domestic = (Domestic * 1e9) / Population,
                External = (External * 1e9) / Population)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Could not align population to the debt series (", conditionMessage(e), ") -- falling back to sheet data.")
    NULL
  })
  if (is.null(debt_pc_df)) debt_pc_df <- key_metrics_trend_df[0, ][, "Quarter", drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(debt_pc_df) > 0) {
    has_debt_pc_live    <- TRUE
    debt_pc_source_note <- "Source: Kenya Debt Counter live API"
  }
}

if (!has_debt_pc_live && has_debt_pc) {
  if (key_metrics_has_composition) {
    # Sheet fallback with a Domestic/External breakdown, computed the same
    # way as the live path: each series divided by the same population.
    debt_pc_df <- df_all %>%
      select(Quarter, Total, Domestic, External) %>%
      inner_join(df_pop %>% rename(Pop = Value), by = "Quarter") %>%
      transmute(Quarter = parse_quarter_label(as.character(Quarter)),
                Total    = (Total    * 1e9) / (Pop * 1e6),
                Domestic = (Domestic * 1e9) / (Pop * 1e6),
                External = (External * 1e9) / (Pop * 1e6))
  } else {
    # No Domestic/External split available in the fallback data -- Total
    # per capita only, Domestic/External left NA (dropped before plotting).
    debt_pc_df <- df_debt_pc %>%
      transmute(Quarter = parse_quarter_label(as.character(Quarter)),
                Total = Debt_per_Capita_KSh,
                Domestic = NA_real_,
                External = NA_real_)
  }
  has_debt_pc_live    <- TRUE
  debt_pc_source_note <- "Source: National Treasury / CBK / KNBS via IEA Kenya (Google Sheet)"
}

# ── Reconcile the split to the published Total ──────────────────────────────
# In the source data the published Total and the Domestic/External split do
# not always close exactly (a fraction of a percent -- the kind of gap an
# FX-valuation timing difference on external debt produces). Everything else
# in this report leads with the published Total, so that figure is kept
# exactly as published and the two components are scaled onto it:
#
#   Domestic' = Domestic x Total / (Domestic + External)
#   External' = Total - Domestic'
#
# This preserves the source's own domestic:external ratio to the last
# decimal while guaranteeing the components sum to the Total exactly, in the
# chart's end labels and in the summary table alike. The size of the gap
# being closed is kept in debt_pc_gap_pct_max and disclosed under the table.
debt_pc_gap_pct_max <- NA_real_

if (exists("debt_pc_df") && !is.null(debt_pc_df) && nrow(debt_pc_df) > 0 &&
    all(c("Total", "Domestic", "External") %in% names(debt_pc_df))) {
  debt_pc_parts <- debt_pc_df$Domestic + debt_pc_df$External
  debt_pc_gaps  <- ifelse(
    is.finite(debt_pc_parts) & is.finite(debt_pc_df$Total) & debt_pc_df$Total > 0,
    (debt_pc_parts - debt_pc_df$Total) / debt_pc_df$Total * 100,
    NA_real_
  )
  if (any(is.finite(debt_pc_gaps))) {
    debt_pc_gap_pct_max <- debt_pc_gaps[which.max(abs(ifelse(is.finite(debt_pc_gaps), debt_pc_gaps, 0)))]
  }

  debt_pc_k <- ifelse(
    is.finite(debt_pc_parts) & debt_pc_parts > 0 & is.finite(debt_pc_df$Total),
    debt_pc_df$Total / debt_pc_parts,
    NA_real_
  )
  debt_pc_df$Domestic <- debt_pc_df$Domestic * debt_pc_k
  debt_pc_df$External <- debt_pc_df$Total - debt_pc_df$Domestic
}
```

```{r debt-per-capita-chart, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.3, eval=has_debt_pc_live}
# Same Total/Domestic/External composition treatment as Figure 1 --
# pivot to long format, one coloured line per series, sharing the same
# series_colors used there so the two charts read consistently.
debt_pc_long <- debt_pc_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Total, Domestic, External), names_to = "Series", values_to = "Per_Capita") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Per_Capita)) %>%
  mutate(Series = factor(Series, levels = c("Total", "Domestic", "External")))

debt_pc_endlabels <- debt_pc_long %>%
  group_by(Series) %>%
  filter(Quarter == max(Quarter)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("KSh %s %s", format(round(Per_Capita), big.mark = ","), Series))

# Export the exact data behind this chart (long format: Quarter x Series x
# Per_Capita) to a small Excel file published alongside the PDF via GitHub
# Pages (docs/), mirroring Figure 1's own "Download Excel" link --
# regenerated fresh on every render.
# Figure 2 no longer writes its own Excel file -- it shares the single
# kenya_public_debt_data.xlsx download defined in the key-metrics-total
# chunk (debt_data_xlsx_name/debt_data_download_url/debt_data_xlsx_ok),
# which the debt-data-xlsx-export chunk near the end of the document
# builds from debt_pc_df among other series. Nothing further to compute
# here.

# Same dynamic "As at [date]" curved-arrow callout as Figure 1, pointing at
# the tip of the Total line -- ordinal_suffix()/format_as_at_date() are
# already defined in the key-metrics-total chunk above and persist in the
# shared knitr environment, so they're reused here rather than redefined.
debt_pc_tip        <- debt_pc_endlabels %>% filter(Series == "Total")
debt_pc_asat_label <- format_as_at_date(debt_pc_tip$Quarter)

debt_pc_xspan <- as.numeric(max(debt_pc_long$Quarter) - min(debt_pc_long$Quarter))

# Y-axis ticks step every KSh 50,000 per capita, labelled "KSh 0K" ..
# "KSh 250K" (etc.) -- same "round up to the next break" logic as Figure
# 1's KSh-2-Trillion ticks, just rescaled for per-capita magnitude. Driven
# off the Total series, which is always the largest of the three.
debt_pc_y_top_break <- ceiling(max(debt_pc_long$Per_Capita) / 50000) * 50000

debt_pc_asat_x <- debt_pc_tip$Quarter - debt_pc_xspan * 0.10
debt_pc_asat_y <- debt_pc_y_top_break - 50000 * 0.20

ggplot(debt_pc_long, aes(x = Quarter, y = Per_Capita, colour = Series, group = Series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = series_colors) +
  geom_text(data = debt_pc_endlabels,
            aes(x = Quarter, y = Per_Capita, label = label, colour = Series),
            hjust = 0, nudge_x = 250, size = 2.3, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  annotate("curve",
           x = debt_pc_asat_x, y = debt_pc_asat_y,
           xend = debt_pc_tip$Quarter, yend = debt_pc_tip$Per_Capita,
           curvature = -0.2, angle = 90,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inches"), type = "closed"),
           linewidth = 0.4, colour = "gray30") +
  annotate("text",
           x = debt_pc_asat_x - 4, y = debt_pc_asat_y,
           label = debt_pc_asat_label,
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.3, fontface = "italic",
           colour = "gray30") +
  key_metrics_x_scale() +
  key_metrics_year_layer +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, debt_pc_y_top_break, by = 50000),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("KSh %dK", as.integer(round(x / 1000))),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.14))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_gdocs() +
  key_metrics_x_theme +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(min(debt_pc_long$Quarter), max(debt_pc_long$Quarter)),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 16, r = 80, b = 65, l = 5.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 8))
```

```{r debt-per-capita-summary, results='asis'}
# Same Domestic/External/Total composition table as the Figure 1 summary
# (debt-snapshot-summary/debt-snapshot-table above), reusing its already-
# computed time points (prev_q_end_date, q_end_date, asat_row$Quarter) and
# column labels (col1_label/col2_label/col3_label) for consistency -- but
# showing KSh-per-capita figures in each cell instead of percentages.
debt_pc_summary_ok <- tryCatch({
  if (!debt_summary_ok) stop("Figure 1 summary table unavailable -- its date points/labels are reused here.")

  fmt_pc <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) return("n/a")
    paste0("KSh ", format(round(x), big.mark = ","))
  }

  # Interpolated to the exact quarter-end date rather than snapped back to
  # the closest earlier monthly point -- see value_at_date(). "Q1 Mar 2026"
  # is the stock as at 31 March 2026, not as at 1 March.
  debt_pc_cols       <- c("Total", "Domestic", "External")
  debt_pc_prev_q_row <- value_at_date(debt_pc_df, prev_q_end_date, debt_pc_cols)
  debt_pc_q_row      <- value_at_date(debt_pc_df, q_end_date,      debt_pc_cols)
  debt_pc_asat_row   <- debt_pc_df[which.max(debt_pc_df$Quarter), ]

  # Round for display in a way that cannot break the addition: Total and
  # Domestic are rounded to whole shillings, and External is taken as the
  # difference between them. (debt_pc_df is already reconciled at full
  # precision above, so this only absorbs the sub-shilling rounding.)
  pc_column_cells <- function(row) {
    tot <- round(row$Total)
    dom <- round(row$Domestic)
    ext <- if (is.finite(tot) && is.finite(dom)) tot - dom else NA_real_
    c(fmt_pc(dom), fmt_pc(ext), fmt_pc(tot))
  }

  debt_pc_summary_table <- data.frame(Metric = c("Domestic", "External", "Total"),
                                       check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  debt_pc_summary_table[[col1_label]] <- pc_column_cells(debt_pc_prev_q_row)
  debt_pc_summary_table[[col2_label]] <- pc_column_cells(debt_pc_q_row)
  debt_pc_summary_table[[col3_label]] <- pc_column_cells(debt_pc_asat_row)

  # --- Narrative paragraph printed above the table -------------------------
  # Mirrors the Figure 1 snapshot paragraph, but on a per-person basis: the
  # latest per-capita point (the same tip Figure 2's "As at" arrow marks),
  # its multiple of the per-person figure a decade earlier, and how much new
  # debt per person has been added over the most recent twelve months.
  debt_pc_latest <- debt_pc_df[which.max(debt_pc_df$Quarter), ]

  debt_pc_10y_row <- closest_on_or_before(debt_pc_df, years_back_date(debt_pc_latest$Quarter, 10))
  debt_pc_1y_row  <- closest_on_or_before(debt_pc_df, years_back_date(debt_pc_latest$Quarter, 1))

  debt_pc_10y_mult <- sprintf("%.1f", debt_pc_latest$Total / debt_pc_10y_row$Total)

  # Annual pace of accumulation = the actual change in per-person debt over
  # the last twelve months of the series, divided by the exact length of
  # that window in years (so a slightly short/long window still annualises).
  debt_pc_yr_span <- as.numeric(debt_pc_latest$Quarter - debt_pc_1y_row$Quarter) / 365.25
  debt_pc_annual_add <- if (is.finite(debt_pc_yr_span) && debt_pc_yr_span > 0) {
    (debt_pc_latest$Total - debt_pc_1y_row$Total) / debt_pc_yr_span
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  debt_pc_narrative <- sprintf(
    "\n**%s**, the public debt is estimated at **%s per person**, and is **%s times** what it was a decade ago without correcting for inflation. As per the trend, approximately **%s** of new debt is added per person annually. The composition of debt per person has evolved as follows:\n\n",
    format_as_at_date(debt_pc_latest$Quarter),
    fmt_pc(debt_pc_latest$Total),
    debt_pc_10y_mult,
    fmt_pc(debt_pc_annual_add)
  )

  TRUE
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Could not build the debt-per-capita summary table (", conditionMessage(e), ") -- section omitted from this render.")
  FALSE
})

if (debt_pc_summary_ok) {
  cat(debt_pc_narrative)
}
```

```{r debt-pc-bullets, results='asis', eval=debt_pc_summary_ok}
# Three concrete readings of the per-person figure in Table 2. Everything
# here is computed from data already in hand at this point in the document
# (Figures 1 and 2) -- knitr chunks run in order, so the sustainability
# inputs further down do not exist yet and cannot be quoted numerically.
# The forward reference to that section is therefore textual only.
illustrative_household <- 4   # KNBS puts the average household near four

pc_household <- debt_pc_latest$Total * illustrative_household
pc_daily     <- debt_pc_annual_add / 365.25
pc_daily_hh  <- pc_daily * illustrative_household

pc_1y_row <- value_at_date(debt_pc_df, years_back_date(debt_pc_latest$Quarter, 1),
                           c("Total", "Domestic", "External"))
pc_dom_1y <- debt_pc_latest$Domestic - pc_1y_row$Domestic
pc_ext_1y <- debt_pc_latest$External - pc_1y_row$External

cat("\\begin{itemize}[itemsep=5pt, parsep=0pt, topsep=2pt, leftmargin=1.4em]\n")

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item \\textbf{What it means in cash terms.} Clearing the debt stock today would require \\textbf{%s} from every man, woman and child in Kenya -- roughly \\textbf{%s} for a household of four. A decade ago the same claim stood at %s a person.\n",
  fmt_pc(debt_pc_latest$Total), fmt_pc(pc_household), fmt_pc(debt_pc_10y_row$Total)
))

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item \\textbf{The burden is compounding, not static.} Each person's share grows by about \\textbf{%s a year} -- close to \\textbf{%s every day}, or \\textbf{%s a day for a household of four} -- before a single shilling of it is repaid.\n",
  fmt_pc(debt_pc_annual_add), fmt_pc(pc_daily), fmt_pc(pc_daily_hh)
))

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item \\textbf{Policy implication -- the mix, not just the total.} Domestic borrowing accounts for \\textbf{%s} of each person's share against \\textbf{%s} external, and added \\textbf{%s} a person over the past year against \\textbf{%s} externally. Domestic debt is the more expensive of the two (see the Debt Sustainability Analysis), so the servicing cost carried by each Kenyan is rising faster than the burden itself -- stabilising it depends on the borrowing mix and the primary balance, not on the headline total alone.\n",
  fmt_pc(debt_pc_latest$Domestic), fmt_pc(debt_pc_latest$External),
  fmt_pc(pc_dom_1y), fmt_pc(pc_ext_1y)
))

cat("\\end{itemize}\n\n")
```

### Figure 3. Trends in the Public Debt (% of GDP)

```{r fig3-gdp-data}
# Debt as a share of GDP, built from exactly the same combined
# Total/Domestic/External debt series behind Figures 1 and 2
# (key_metrics_trend_df), divided by nominal GDP pulled live from the Kenya
# Debt Counter GDP endpoint -- the sibling of the population endpoint used
# by Figure 2, and read the same way. Falls back to the Google Sheet's GDP
# indicator if the live endpoint is unavailable.
GDP_API_HISTORICAL <- "https://api.kenyadebtcounter.or.ke/api/indicators/gdp/historical"

api_gdp_hist <- tryCatch({
  resp <- request(GDP_API_HISTORICAL) %>%
    req_user_agent("IEA-Kenya-QuarterlyReport/1.0 (+quarto render)") %>%
    req_timeout(25) %>%
    req_perform()
  parsed <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  if (!isTRUE(parsed$success) || is.null(parsed$data) || nrow(parsed$data) == 0) {
    stop("API responded but returned no usable data (success=", parsed$success, ")")
  }
  parsed$data %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(month_label = format(date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
    group_by(month_label) %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    transmute(date, GDP = as.numeric(value))
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Live GDP API unavailable (", conditionMessage(e), ") -- falling back to the GDP sheet.")
  NULL
})

has_debt_gdp_live       <- FALSE
debt_gdp_source_note    <- NULL
debt_gdp_projected_from <- NA

if (!is.null(api_gdp_hist) && nrow(api_gdp_hist) >= 2) {
  debt_gdp_df <- tryCatch({
    g <- api_gdp_hist[order(api_gdp_hist$date), ]

    # The GDP series typically ends months behind the debt series, which runs
    # right up to today. Left as-is that strands Figure 3 (and every column of
    # its table) back at the last GDP point. So GDP is carried forward to the
    # debt series' own last date along the slope of its most recent twelve
    # months: nominal GDP moves smoothly, and the debt series it is divided by
    # is itself already carried forward to today in the same way.
    debt_last_date         <- max(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter)
    if (nrow(g) >= 2 && debt_last_date > max(g$date)) {
      g_last_date <- max(g$date)
      g_recent    <- g[g$date >= (g_last_date - 400), ]
      if (nrow(g_recent) < 2) g_recent <- g[(nrow(g) - 1):nrow(g), ]
      slope_per_day <- (g_recent$GDP[nrow(g_recent)] - g_recent$GDP[1]) /
                        as.numeric(g_recent$date[nrow(g_recent)] - g_recent$date[1])
      if (is.finite(slope_per_day)) {
        g <- bind_rows(g, tibble(
          date = debt_last_date,
          GDP  = g$GDP[nrow(g)] + slope_per_day * as.numeric(debt_last_date - g_last_date)
        ))
        debt_gdp_projected_from <- g_last_date
      }
    }

    # rule = 1 (not 2): before the GDP series starts the result is NA and
    # those debt months are dropped, rather than dividing 1999 debt by a
    # flat-held modern GDP figure. The forward end is covered by the
    # projection above rather than by flat extension.
    gdp_on_debt <- approx(x = as.numeric(g$date), y = g$GDP,
                          xout = as.numeric(key_metrics_trend_df$Quarter),
                          rule = 1)$y

    # The debt series is in KSh billions and this assumes the GDP endpoint
    # publishes raw KSh (as the population endpoint publishes raw persons).
    # If the ratios that produces are implausible as percentages, the
    # endpoint is publishing billions instead -- rescale rather than emit a
    # chart that is wrong by nine orders of magnitude.
    gdp_probe <- median((key_metrics_trend_df$Total * 1e9) / gdp_on_debt * 100, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.finite(gdp_probe) && gdp_probe > 1000) gdp_on_debt <- gdp_on_debt * 1e9

    key_metrics_trend_df %>%
      mutate(GDP = gdp_on_debt) %>%
      filter(is.finite(GDP), GDP > 0) %>%
      transmute(Quarter,
                Total    = (Total    * 1e9) / GDP * 100,
                Domestic = (Domestic * 1e9) / GDP * 100,
                External = (External * 1e9) / GDP * 100)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Could not align GDP to the debt series (", conditionMessage(e), ") -- falling back to the GDP sheet.")
    NULL
  })

  if (!is.null(debt_gdp_df) && nrow(debt_gdp_df) > 0) {
    has_debt_gdp_live    <- TRUE
    debt_gdp_source_note <- "Source: Kenya Debt Counter live API"
  }
}

if (!has_debt_gdp_live && has_gdp) {
  # Sheet fallback -- df_all and df_gdp are both already in KSh billions,
  # so the ratio is direct with no unit conversion.
  debt_gdp_df <- tryCatch({
    df_all %>%
      select(Quarter, Total, Domestic, External) %>%
      inner_join(df_gdp %>% rename(GDP = Value), by = "Quarter") %>%
      filter(is.finite(GDP), GDP > 0) %>%
      transmute(Quarter   = parse_quarter_label(as.character(Quarter)),
                Total     = Total    / GDP * 100,
                Domestic  = Domestic / GDP * 100,
                External  = External / GDP * 100)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Sheet GDP fallback unavailable (", conditionMessage(e), ").")
    NULL
  })
  if (!is.null(debt_gdp_df) && nrow(debt_gdp_df) > 0) {
    has_debt_gdp_live    <- TRUE
    debt_gdp_source_note <- "Source: KNBS / National Treasury via IEA Kenya (Google Sheet)"
  }
}

# Same reconciliation as Figure 2: the published Total is kept exactly and
# the two components are scaled onto it, so every column of the table below
# sums to its Total while preserving the source's own domestic:external
# ratio. The gap being closed is disclosed underneath the table.
debt_gdp_gap_pct_max <- NA_real_

if (has_debt_gdp_live && all(c("Total", "Domestic", "External") %in% names(debt_gdp_df))) {
  debt_gdp_parts <- debt_gdp_df$Domestic + debt_gdp_df$External
  debt_gdp_gaps  <- ifelse(
    is.finite(debt_gdp_parts) & is.finite(debt_gdp_df$Total) & debt_gdp_df$Total > 0,
    (debt_gdp_parts - debt_gdp_df$Total) / debt_gdp_df$Total * 100,
    NA_real_
  )
  if (any(is.finite(debt_gdp_gaps))) {
    debt_gdp_gap_pct_max <- debt_gdp_gaps[which.max(abs(ifelse(is.finite(debt_gdp_gaps), debt_gdp_gaps, 0)))]
  }
  debt_gdp_k <- ifelse(
    is.finite(debt_gdp_parts) & debt_gdp_parts > 0 & is.finite(debt_gdp_df$Total),
    debt_gdp_df$Total / debt_gdp_parts,
    NA_real_
  )
  debt_gdp_df$Domestic <- debt_gdp_df$Domestic * debt_gdp_k
  debt_gdp_df$External <- debt_gdp_df$Total - debt_gdp_df$Domestic
}
```

```{r fig3-gdp-chart, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.3, eval=has_debt_gdp_live}
# Same three-series treatment as Figures 1 and 2, sharing series_colors so
# Total/Domestic/External read the same colour across all three charts.
debt_gdp_long <- debt_gdp_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Total, Domestic, External), names_to = "Series", values_to = "Ratio") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ratio)) %>%
  mutate(Series = factor(Series, levels = c("Total", "Domestic", "External")))

debt_gdp_endlabels <- debt_gdp_long %>%
  group_by(Series) %>%
  filter(Quarter == max(Quarter)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(label = sprintf("%.1f%% %s", Ratio, Series))

# Figure 3 no longer writes its own Excel file either -- same shared
# kenya_public_debt_data.xlsx download as Figures 1 and 2
# (debt_data_xlsx_name/debt_data_download_url/debt_data_xlsx_ok, defined in
# the key-metrics-total chunk), built in the debt-data-xlsx-export chunk
# right after this section from debt_gdp_df among the other series.

debt_gdp_tip        <- debt_gdp_endlabels %>% filter(Series == "Total")
debt_gdp_asat_label <- format_as_at_date(debt_gdp_tip$Quarter)

debt_gdp_xspan <- as.numeric(max(debt_gdp_long$Quarter) - min(debt_gdp_long$Quarter))

# Y-axis ticks every 10 percentage points, rounded up to the next tick above
# the highest point -- same "next break up" logic as Figures 1 and 2.
debt_gdp_y_top_break <- ceiling(max(debt_gdp_long$Ratio) / 10) * 10

debt_gdp_asat_x <- debt_gdp_tip$Quarter - debt_gdp_xspan * 0.10
debt_gdp_asat_y <- debt_gdp_y_top_break - 10 * 0.20

ggplot(debt_gdp_long, aes(x = Quarter, y = Ratio, colour = Series, group = Series)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = series_colors) +
  geom_text(data = debt_gdp_endlabels,
            aes(x = Quarter, y = Ratio, label = label, colour = Series),
            hjust = 0, nudge_x = 250, size = 2.3, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  annotate("curve",
           x = debt_gdp_asat_x, y = debt_gdp_asat_y,
           xend = debt_gdp_tip$Quarter, yend = debt_gdp_tip$Ratio,
           curvature = -0.2, angle = 90,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inches"), type = "closed"),
           linewidth = 0.4, colour = "gray30") +
  annotate("text",
           x = debt_gdp_asat_x - 4, y = debt_gdp_asat_y,
           label = debt_gdp_asat_label,
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.3, fontface = "italic",
           colour = "gray30") +
  key_metrics_x_scale() +
  key_metrics_year_layer +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, debt_gdp_y_top_break, by = 10),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%d%%", as.integer(round(x))),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.14))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_gdocs() +
  key_metrics_x_theme +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(min(debt_gdp_long$Quarter), max(debt_gdp_long$Quarter)),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 16, r = 80, b = 65, l = 5.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 8))
```
