```{r debt-data-xlsx-export, results='asis'}
# Builds the single shared kenya_public_debt_data.xlsx workbook that all
# three figures' "Download Excel" links point at (debt_data_download_url,
# defined in the key-metrics-total chunk). Runs here because it needs
# debt_pc_df (Figure 2) and debt_gdp_df (Figure 3) as well as
# key_metrics_trend_df (Figure 1) -- all three are finished computing by
# this point. Three sheets:
#   1. Snapshot     -- latest date only, Domestic/External/Total across
#                      all four blocks, for someone who just wants "the
#                      current numbers" without opening the full series.
#   2. Full Data    -- Date x {Amount, Proportion, Per Capita, As % of
#                      GDP} x {Domestic, External, Total}, most recent
#                      date first. Amount is KSh Billion as published.
#                      Proportion is each series' share of that date's
#                      Total (Domestic/Total, External/Total, and
#                      Total/Total which is always 100%), x100 and
#                      rounded to a whole number. Per Capita is
#                      debt_pc_df rounded (already KSh, no rescaling).
#                      As % of GDP is debt_gdp_df rounded -- it is
#                      already ratio x 100 from the Figure 3 computation,
#                      so this rounds rather than re-multiplying by 100.
#   3. Notes & Sources -- units, data sources, the domestic/external
#                      reconciliation method, and when this was generated.
debt_data_xlsx_write_ok <- tryCatch({
  if (!requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) stop("openxlsx not installed")

  amount_df <- key_metrics_trend_df %>%
    transmute(Date = Quarter,
              Amount__Domestic = Domestic,
              Amount__External = External,
              Amount__Total    = Total) %>%
    mutate(
      Proportion__Domestic = round(Amount__Domestic / Amount__Total * 100),
      Proportion__External = round(Amount__External / Amount__Total * 100),
      Proportion__Total    = round(Amount__Total    / Amount__Total * 100)
    )

  pc_df <- if (exists("debt_pc_df") && !is.null(debt_pc_df) && nrow(debt_pc_df) > 0) {
    debt_pc_df %>%
      transmute(Date = Quarter,
                PerCapita__Domestic = round(Domestic),
                PerCapita__External = round(External),
                PerCapita__Total    = round(Total))
  } else {
    tibble(Date = as.Date(character()), PerCapita__Domestic = numeric(),
           PerCapita__External = numeric(), PerCapita__Total = numeric())
  }

  gdp_df <- if (exists("debt_gdp_df") && !is.null(debt_gdp_df) && nrow(debt_gdp_df) > 0) {
    debt_gdp_df %>%
      transmute(Date = Quarter,
                PctGDP__Domestic = round(Domestic),
                PctGDP__External = round(External),
                PctGDP__Total    = round(Total))
  } else {
    tibble(Date = as.Date(character()), PctGDP__Domestic = numeric(),
           PctGDP__External = numeric(), PctGDP__Total = numeric())
  }

  debt_data_wide <- amount_df %>%
    left_join(pc_df,  by = "Date") %>%
    left_join(gdp_df, by = "Date") %>%
    arrange(desc(Date))

  out_cols <- c("Date",
                "Amount__Domestic", "Amount__External", "Amount__Total",
                "Proportion__Domestic", "Proportion__External", "Proportion__Total",
                "PerCapita__Domestic", "PerCapita__External", "PerCapita__Total",
                "PctGDP__Domestic", "PctGDP__External", "PctGDP__Total")
  debt_data_wide <- debt_data_wide[, out_cols]

  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

  hdr_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center",
                                      valign = "center", border = "TopBottomLeftRight",
                                      fgFill = "#1F3864", fontColour = "#FFFFFF", wrapText = TRUE)
  title_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(fontSize = 13, textDecoration = "bold")
  note_style  <- openxlsx::createStyle(fontSize = 10, fontColour = "#595959")
  section_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(fontSize = 11, textDecoration = "bold",
                                          fgFill = "#D9E1F2")

  # ---- Sheet 1: Snapshot --------------------------------------------------
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "Snapshot")
  latest <- debt_data_wide[1, ]
  snapshot_asat <- format_as_at_date(latest$Date)

  snapshot_tbl <- data.frame(
    Metric   = c("Amount (KSh Billion)", "Proportion (%)", "Per Capita (KSh)", "As % of GDP (%)"),
    Domestic = c(latest$Amount__Domestic, latest$Proportion__Domestic,
                 latest$PerCapita__Domestic, latest$PctGDP__Domestic),
    External = c(latest$Amount__External, latest$Proportion__External,
                 latest$PerCapita__External, latest$PctGDP__External),
    Total    = c(latest$Amount__Total, latest$Proportion__Total,
                 latest$PerCapita__Total, latest$PctGDP__Total),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Snapshot", "Kenya Public Debt -- Snapshot", startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Snapshot", title_style, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Snapshot", snapshot_asat, startRow = 2, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Snapshot", note_style, rows = 2, cols = 1)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Snapshot", snapshot_tbl, startRow = 4, startCol = 1,
                       headerStyle = hdr_style)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Snapshot", openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "#,##0"),
                      rows = 5:8, cols = 2:4, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "Snapshot", cols = 1:4, widths = c(24, 14, 14, 14))
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Snapshot",
                       "See the Full Data sheet for the complete time series, and Notes & Sources for units and methodology.",
                       startRow = 10, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Snapshot", note_style, rows = 10, cols = 1)

  # ---- Sheet 2: Full Data --------------------------------------------------
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "Full Data")

  group_header_row <- 1
  col_header_row   <- 2
  data_start_row   <- 3

  group_labels <- matrix(c("", "Amount", "", "", "Proportion", "", "",
                            "Per Capita", "", "", "As % of GDP", "", ""), nrow = 1)
  col_labels   <- matrix(c("Date",
                            "Domestic", "External", "Total",
                            "Domestic (%)", "External (%)", "Total (%)",
                            "Domestic", "External", "Total",
                            "Domestic (%)", "External (%)", "Total (%)"), nrow = 1)

  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Full Data", group_labels,
                       startRow = group_header_row, startCol = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Full Data", col_labels,
                       startRow = col_header_row, startCol = 1, colNames = FALSE)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Full Data", debt_data_wide,
                       startRow = data_start_row, startCol = 1, colNames = FALSE)

  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "Full Data", cols = 1,     rows = group_header_row:col_header_row)
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "Full Data", cols = 2:4,   rows = group_header_row)
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "Full Data", cols = 5:7,   rows = group_header_row)
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "Full Data", cols = 8:10,  rows = group_header_row)
  openxlsx::mergeCells(wb, "Full Data", cols = 11:13, rows = group_header_row)

  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Full Data", hdr_style,
                      rows = group_header_row:col_header_row, cols = 1:13,
                      gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Full Data", openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = "yyyy-mm-dd"),
                      rows = data_start_row:(data_start_row + nrow(debt_data_wide) - 1), cols = 1,
                      gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)

  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "Full Data", cols = 1:13, widths = c(12, rep(11, 12)))
  openxlsx::freezePane(wb, "Full Data", firstActiveRow = data_start_row, firstActiveCol = 2)

  # ---- Sheet 3: Notes & Sources -------------------------------------------
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "Notes & Sources")
  r <- 1
  write_line <- function(txt, style = NULL, blank_after = FALSE) {
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Notes & Sources", txt, startRow = r, startCol = 1)
    if (!is.null(style)) openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Notes & Sources", style, rows = r, cols = 1)
    r <<- r + 1 + as.integer(blank_after)
  }

  write_line("Kenya Public Debt -- Notes & Sources", title_style, blank_after = TRUE)
  write_line(sprintf("Generated: %s", format(Sys.time(), "%d %B %Y, %H:%M %Z")))
  write_line("Report: IEA Kenya Quarterly Macro & Public Debt Report", blank_after = TRUE)

  write_line("Units", section_style)
  write_line("Amount: KSh Billion (as published by source).")
  write_line("Proportion: each series' share of that date's Total debt, as a percentage (Domestic/Total, External/Total; Total/Total is always 100%).")
  write_line("Per Capita: KSh per person, Total/Domestic/External debt divided by population on the same date.")
  write_line("As % of GDP: Total/Domestic/External debt divided by nominal GDP on the same date, as a percentage.", blank_after = TRUE)

  write_line("Data sources", section_style)
  if (exists("key_metrics_source_note"))  write_line(paste("Amount:", key_metrics_source_note))
  if (exists("debt_pc_source_note") && !is.null(debt_pc_source_note))    write_line(paste("Per Capita:", debt_pc_source_note))
  if (exists("debt_gdp_source_note") && !is.null(debt_gdp_source_note)) write_line(paste("As % of GDP:", debt_gdp_source_note))
  r <- r + 1

  write_line("Methodology note", section_style)
  write_line("Where the published Total and the Domestic/External split do not sum exactly (a fraction of a percent, typically an FX-valuation timing difference on external debt), Domestic is scaled onto the published Total (Domestic' = Domestic x Total / (Domestic+External)) and External is taken as the remainder (External' = Total - Domestic'). This keeps the published Total exact and preserves the source's own domestic:external ratio to the last decimal.")
  if (exists("debt_pc_gap_pct_max") && is.finite(debt_pc_gap_pct_max)) {
    write_line(sprintf("Largest such gap closed in the Per Capita series: %.2f%%.", debt_pc_gap_pct_max))
  }
  if (exists("debt_gdp_gap_pct_max") && is.finite(debt_gdp_gap_pct_max)) {
    write_line(sprintf("Largest such gap closed in the As %% of GDP series: %.2f%%.", debt_gdp_gap_pct_max))
  }

  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "Notes & Sources", cols = 1, widths = 110)

  if (!dir.exists("docs")) dir.create("docs")
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, file.path("docs", debt_data_xlsx_name), overwrite = TRUE)
  TRUE
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Could not write the consolidated debt-data Excel export (",
          conditionMessage(e), ") -- docs/", debt_data_xlsx_name,
          " was left as whatever a previous render produced.")
  FALSE
})
```

```{r fig3-gdp-summary, results='asis'}
# Narrative + composition table, matching Figures 1 and 2: same three time
# points and same column labels, with each cell expressed as a share of GDP.
debt_gdp_summary_ok <- tryCatch({
  if (!has_debt_gdp_live) stop("no debt-to-GDP series available this render")
  if (!debt_summary_ok)   stop("Figure 1 summary table unavailable -- its date points/labels are reused here.")

  fmt_gdp <- function(x) {
    if (!is.finite(x)) return("n/a")
    sprintf("%.1f%%", x)
  }

  gdp_cols            <- c("Total", "Domestic", "External")
  debt_gdp_prev_q_row <- value_at_date(debt_gdp_df, prev_q_end_date, gdp_cols)
  debt_gdp_q_row      <- value_at_date(debt_gdp_df, q_end_date,      gdp_cols)
  debt_gdp_asat_row   <- debt_gdp_df[which.max(debt_gdp_df$Quarter), ]

  # Round in a way that cannot break the addition: Total and Domestic are
  # rounded, External is taken as the difference between them.
  gdp_column_cells <- function(row) {
    tot <- round(row$Total, 1)
    dom <- round(row$Domestic, 1)
    ext <- if (is.finite(tot) && is.finite(dom)) round(tot - dom, 1) else NA_real_
    c(fmt_gdp(dom), fmt_gdp(ext), fmt_gdp(tot))
  }

  debt_gdp_summary_table <- data.frame(Metric = c("Domestic", "External", "Total"),
                                        check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  debt_gdp_summary_table[[col1_label]] <- gdp_column_cells(debt_gdp_prev_q_row)
  debt_gdp_summary_table[[col2_label]] <- gdp_column_cells(debt_gdp_q_row)
  debt_gdp_summary_table[[col3_label]] <- gdp_column_cells(debt_gdp_asat_row)

  # Decade-ago comparison, in percentage points rather than a multiple --
  # the series is already a ratio, so "x times" would not read sensibly.
  debt_gdp_latest  <- debt_gdp_asat_row
  debt_gdp_10y_row <- value_at_date(debt_gdp_df, years_back_date(debt_gdp_latest$Quarter, 10), gdp_cols)
  debt_gdp_10y_chg <- debt_gdp_latest$Total - debt_gdp_10y_row$Total

  debt_gdp_narrative <- sprintf(
    "\n**%s**, the public debt as a share of GDP now stands at **%s**, compared with **%s** a decade ago -- a change of **%.1f percentage points**. The composition of debt relative to GDP has evolved as follows:\n\n",
    format_as_at_date(debt_gdp_latest$Quarter),
    fmt_gdp(debt_gdp_latest$Total),
    fmt_gdp(debt_gdp_10y_row$Total),
    debt_gdp_10y_chg
  )

  TRUE
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Could not build the debt-to-GDP summary (", conditionMessage(e), ") -- section omitted from this render.")
  FALSE
})

if (debt_gdp_summary_ok) {
  cat(debt_gdp_narrative)
}
```

```{r debt-gdp-bullets, results='asis', eval=debt_gdp_summary_ok}
# Three short readings of the ratio in Table 3. Everything emitted here is
# RAW LaTeX, so every percent sign must be escaped -- pct() does that; the
# plain fmt_gdp() used by the table above must never be used here.
pct <- function(x, d = 1) {
  if (!is.finite(x)) return("n/a")
  sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f\\%%"), x)
}

gdp3_cols   <- c("Total", "Domestic", "External")
gdp3_months <- debt_gdp_latest$Total / 100 * 12

# Twelve-month movements, plus the implied level of nominal GDP (the debt
# stock divided by its own ratio), which puts pending bills on the same
# basis as the ratio in Table 3.
gdp3_ok <- tryCatch({
  gdp3_1y   <- value_at_date(debt_gdp_df, years_back_date(debt_gdp_latest$Quarter, 1), gdp3_cols)
  debt3_now <- value_at_date(key_metrics_trend_df, debt_gdp_latest$Quarter, "Total")
  debt3_1y  <- value_at_date(key_metrics_trend_df,
                             years_back_date(debt_gdp_latest$Quarter, 1), "Total")

  gdp3_1y_chg  <- debt_gdp_latest$Total - gdp3_1y$Total
  debt3_growth <- (debt3_now$Total / debt3_1y$Total - 1) * 100
  gdp3_now_lvl <- debt3_now$Total / (debt_gdp_latest$Total / 100)
  gdp3_growth  <- (gdp3_now_lvl / (debt3_1y$Total / (gdp3_1y$Total / 100)) - 1) * 100
  pending_pct_gdp <- (pending_bills_trillion * 1000) / gdp3_now_lvl * 100

  all(is.finite(c(gdp3_1y_chg, debt3_growth, gdp3_growth, pending_pct_gdp)))
}, error = function(e) FALSE)

# Prefer the sheet's own GDP growth indicator; fall back to the declared value.
real_growth <- if (exists("has_gdp_g") && isTRUE(has_gdp_g)) {
  tryCatch(as.numeric(tail(df_gdp_g$Value, 1)), error = function(e) real_gdp_growth_fallback)
} else {
  real_gdp_growth_fallback
}
if (!is.finite(real_growth)) real_growth <- real_gdp_growth_fallback

# Optional clauses, kept out of the bullet text so each bullet is one call.
frag_pend <- if (gdp3_ok) sprintf(" (about %s of GDP)", pct(pending_pct_gdp)) else ""
frag_grow <- if (gdp3_ok) sprintf(
  " -- over the past year debt grew \\textbf{%s} against nominal GDP of \\textbf{%s}",
  pct(debt3_growth), pct(gdp3_growth)) else ""

cat("\\begin{itemize}[itemsep=5pt, parsep=0pt, topsep=2pt, leftmargin=1.4em]\n")

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item \\textbf{The ratio is high and still climbing.} At \\textbf{%s of GDP} -- roughly \\textbf{%.0f months} of national output -- up \\textbf{%.1f percentage points} over the decade. Figure 3 shows a sustained net increase in the debt stock; the sharp decline in early 2024 is on account of the bullet repayment of the Eurobond.\n",
  pct(debt_gdp_latest$Total), gdp3_months, debt_gdp_10y_chg
))

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item \\textbf{Domestic debt is rising faster, and the stock is not the whole claim.} Domestic borrowing equals \\textbf{%s of GDP} against \\textbf{%s} external. Pending bills of \\textbf{KSh %.1f trillion}%s sit outside this ratio -- and servicing already costs \\textbf{KSh %.1f trillion}, \\textbf{%s of it domestic}, the costlier class.\n",
  pct(debt_gdp_latest$Domestic), pct(debt_gdp_latest$External),
  pending_bills_trillion, frag_pend,
  service_total_trillion, pct(service_domestic_share)
))

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item \\textbf{Growth is too slow to outrun the servicing bill.} Real growth of about \\textbf{%s} cannot generate the revenue to cover \\textbf{KSh %.1f trillion} of debt service%s. While borrowing outpaces output, servicing absorbs a rising share of revenue and crowds out development spending.\n",
  pct(real_growth), service_total_trillion, frag_grow
))

cat("\\end{itemize}\n\n")
```

# Debt Sustainability Analysis

```{r dsa-intro, results='asis'}
# Two sentences only -- the whole section is budgeted to one page, so the
# argument is carried by the bullets and the two exhibits, not by prose.
dsa_live_ratio <- if (exists("debt_gdp_summary_ok") && isTRUE(debt_gdp_summary_ok)) {
  sprintf("%.1f\\%%", debt_gdp_latest$Total)
} else {
  NA_character_
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Figures 1 to 3 describe a debt stock growing in absolute terms, per person, and relative to the economy that must service it%s. The National Treasury tests whether that burden remains sustainable through a Debt Sustainability Analysis (DSA); on the %s assessment, all four headline indicators have been breached.\n\n",
  if (!is.na(dsa_live_ratio)) sprintf(" -- reaching %s of GDP", dsa_live_ratio) else "",
  mtds_year
))
```

```{r dsa-threshold-table, results='asis'}
# Status is pre-rendered LaTeX (a red bold flag) and so is passed through
# iea_fullwidth_table's raw_cols, which skips escaping for that column.
dsa_threshold_table <- data.frame(
  Indicator = dsa_indicators$Indicator,
  Threshold = sprintf("%.0f%%", dsa_indicators$Threshold),
  `Latest Value` = sprintf("%.1f%%", dsa_indicators$Latest),
  Excess = sprintf("+%.1f pp", dsa_indicators$Latest - dsa_indicators$Threshold),
  Status = ifelse(dsa_indicators$Latest > dsa_indicators$Threshold,
                  "\\textcolor{iearedflag}{\\textbf{Breached}}",
                  "\\textcolor{ieagreen}{\\textbf{Within}}"),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat(iea_fullwidth_table(
  dsa_threshold_table, raw_cols = "Status",
  caption = sprintf("Debt sustainability indicators against thresholds, %s", mtds_year)
))
cat(sprintf(
  "\n\\vspace{-0.9em}\n\\begin{flushleft}\n{\\scriptsize\\color{gray} Source: National Treasury, Medium Term Debt Strategy (MTDS), %s.}\n\\end{flushleft}\n\\vspace{0.2em}\n",
  mtds_year
))
```

```{r dsa-findings, results='asis'}
# Raw LaTeX itemize with enumitem spacing options rather than markdown
# bullets: the tight list keeps the whole section on one page, and doing it
# here rather than globally leaves every other list in the report untouched.
dsa_worst <- dsa_indicators[which.max(dsa_indicators$Latest / dsa_indicators$Threshold), ]

cat("\\begin{itemize}[noitemsep, topsep=1pt, leftmargin=1.4em]\n")

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item The present value of public debt stands at \\textbf{%.1f\\%% of GDP} against a \\textbf{%.0f\\%%} benchmark -- an overshoot of \\textbf{%.1f percentage points}.\n",
  dsa_indicators$Latest[1], dsa_indicators$Threshold[1],
  dsa_indicators$Latest[1] - dsa_indicators$Threshold[1]
))

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item All three external indicators are also breached, with \\textbf{%s} furthest beyond its limit at \\textbf{%.1f\\%%} against \\textbf{%.0f\\%%}.\n",
  dsa_worst$Indicator, dsa_worst$Latest, dsa_worst$Threshold
))

cat("\\item Every breached measure except the first is assessed against exports or revenue rather than GDP, so the strain falls directly on the government's \\textit{capacity to pay}, not merely on the size of the stock.\n")

cat("\\end{itemize}\n\n")
```

### Figure 4. The Cost of Domestic versus External Debt

```{r dsa-wair-chart, fig.width=7, fig.height=2.3}
# Deliberately the same colour language as Figures 1 to 3 -- Domestic in
# green and External in gold -- so the reader carries the composition split
# straight across from the trend charts into the cost comparison.
wair_df <- data.frame(
  Series = factor(c("Domestic", "External"), levels = c("Domestic", "External")),
  Rate   = c(wair_domestic, wair_external)
)
wair_multiple <- wair_domestic / wair_external

ggplot(wair_df, aes(x = Series, y = Rate, fill = Series)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.42) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = series_colors) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Rate)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold", colour = "gray20") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 2.55, y = wair_domestic * 0.60,
           label = sprintf("Domestic debt costs\n%.1f times more\nthan external debt", wair_multiple),
           hjust = 0.5, size = 2.9, fontface = "italic", colour = "gray30") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%d%%", as.integer(x)),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.7))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_gdocs() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 8, b = 2, l = 5.5))
```

```{r dsa-implications, results='asis'}
# Closing bullets. The stock-versus-service contrast that previously needed
# its own table is carried here as a single line, computed from the same
# live quarter-end row that drives Figures 1 to 3.
cat(sprintf(
  "\n\\vspace{-1.5em}\n\\begin{flushleft}\n{\\scriptsize\\color{gray} Source: National Treasury, MTDS %s. Weighted average interest rate by debt class.}\n\\end{flushleft}\n\\vspace{0.2em}\n",
  mtds_year
))

cat("\\begin{itemize}[noitemsep, topsep=1pt, leftmargin=1.4em]\n")

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item \\textbf{The cause is composition.} Domestic borrowing carries a weighted average interest rate of \\textbf{%.1f\\%%} against \\textbf{%.1f\\%%} on external debt, so each shilling shifted from external to domestic financing costs roughly \\textbf{%.1f times} as much to carry.\n",
  wair_domestic, wair_external, wair_multiple
))

# Only claim the stock-versus-service gap when the live quarter-end row is
# actually available this render; otherwise state the service side alone.
dsa_stock_dom <- tryCatch({
  if (!debt_summary_ok) stop("no live quarter-end row")
  q_end_row$Domestic / q_end_row$Total * 100
}, error = function(e) NA_real_)

if (is.finite(dsa_stock_dom)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "\\item \\textbf{The consequence is the repayment burden.} Domestic debt is \\textbf{%.1f\\%%} of the stock at the close of %s but absorbs \\textbf{%.1f\\%%} of the KSh %.1f trillion debt service budget -- a gap of \\textbf{%.1f percentage points} between what is owed and what must be paid this year. External debt is the mirror image, at \\textbf{%.1f\\%%} of the stock but \\textbf{%.1f\\%%} of repayments.\n",
    dsa_stock_dom, col2_label, service_domestic_share, service_total_trillion,
    service_domestic_share - dsa_stock_dom,
    100 - dsa_stock_dom, service_external_share
  ))
} else {
  cat(sprintf(
    "\\item \\textbf{The consequence is the repayment burden.} Domestic debt absorbs \\textbf{%.1f\\%%} of the KSh %.1f trillion debt service budget against \\textbf{%.1f\\%%} for external debt.\n",
    service_domestic_share, service_total_trillion, service_external_share
  ))
}

cat(sprintf(
  "\\item \\textbf{Direction matters more than level.} A stock growing at the pace of Figure 1, increasingly financed domestically at %.1f\\%%, lifts the servicing bill faster than the stock itself -- which is why the debt service indicators are breached alongside the debt-to-GDP ratio. The MTDS projects the ratio will stay above benchmark until at least \\textbf{%s}.\n",
  wair_domestic, mtds_above_benchmark_until
))

cat("\\end{itemize}\n\n")
```

```{r forex-narrative, eval=has_forex, results='asis'}
latest_fx <- tail(df_forex$Value, 1)
n_fx <- nrow(df_forex)
prev_fx <- if (n_fx >= 2) df_forex$Value[n_fx - 1] else NA

if (!is.na(prev_fx)) {
  fx_change_pct <- ((latest_fx - prev_fx) / prev_fx) * 100
  direction <- ifelse(fx_change_pct > 0, "depreciated", "appreciated")
  cat(sprintf(
    "The Kenya Shilling %s by **%.1f%%** against the US Dollar quarter-on-quarter (from %.2f to %.2f). ",
    direction, abs(fx_change_pct), prev_fx, latest_fx
  ))
  if (has_composition) {
    cat(sprintf(
      "With external debt at **KSh %.1f bn** (%.1f%% of total), exchange rate movements have a material impact on the shilling-denominated value of external obligations.\n",
      latest_ext, ext_share
    ))
  }
} else {
  cat(sprintf("The KES/USD rate stood at **%.2f** in the latest quarter.\n", latest_fx))
}
```

```{r wacd-narrative, eval=has_wacd_joined, results='asis'}
latest_dom_r <- tail(df_wacd_combined$Dom_Rate, 1)
latest_ext_r <- tail(df_wacd_combined$Ext_Rate, 1)
spread <- abs(latest_dom_r - latest_ext_r)

cat(sprintf(
  "The weighted average interest rate on domestic debt was **%.2f%%**, compared to **%.2f%%** on external debt. ",
  latest_dom_r, latest_ext_r
))
cat(sprintf(
  "The spread of **%.2f percentage points** reflects the premium embedded in shorter-tenor, shilling-denominated domestic instruments.\n",
  spread
))

# Annual interest cost estimate
if (has_composition) {
  est_dom_cost <- latest_dom * (latest_dom_r / 100)
  est_ext_cost <- latest_ext * (latest_ext_r / 100)
  est_total_cost <- est_dom_cost + est_ext_cost
  cat(sprintf(
    "\nAt current stock levels and rates, the estimated annual interest bill is approximately **KSh %.1f bn** (domestic: KSh %.1f bn, external: KSh %.1f bn).\n",
    est_total_cost, est_dom_cost, est_ext_cost
  ))
}
```

<!-- 9. METHODOLOGY & SOURCES                                   -->

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->

\newpage

# Data Sources

This report draws on publicly available data published by:

- **Central Bank of Kenya (CBK)** — monthly and quarterly public debt statistics, exchange rates
- **The National Treasury** — budget execution reports, fiscal outturns, cost of debt
- **Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS)** — GDP, national accounts, population estimates

Data is ingested via Google Sheets, processed in R, and rendered using Quarto with XeLaTeX. The report is regenerated automatically through GitHub Actions whenever the underlying data or analysis is updated.

**Definitions:**

- *Domestic debt* — Treasury bills, Treasury bonds, and overdraft at the Central Bank
- *External debt* — bilateral, multilateral, and commercial external obligations
- *Debt-to-GDP* — total public debt as a percentage of nominal GDP
- *Debt per capita* — total public debt divided by estimated population
